name: lessonblocksfield-add-ui-single-block
hook: LessonBlocksField add buttons need to show when rows.length < 2, not only when rows.length === 0
body:
LessonBlocksField's Add Exercise / Add Content Page buttons only showed when the block list was empty (rows.length === 0). This made it impossible to add a 2nd block to test reorder controls when starting from 1 block. The fix changes the condition to rows.length < 2 so the add buttons persist when there's 1 block.

Why: QA reported being unable to verify reorder controls because they could not add a 2nd block — the add UI was hidden once rows.length > 0.
why: A custom field component with empty-state-only add buttons creates a dead-end UX: users with 1 block cannot add more. Always show add buttons until ≥2 blocks exist.
